# cofide_connect_cloud_organization (Resource)

Manages a Cofide Connect cloud organization. A cloud organization represents a cloud provider organization (e.g. an AWS Organization) linked to a Cofide organization and acts as the root for cloud account and resource discovery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ------ Example: ./examples_tmp/resources/cofide_connect_cloud_organization ------
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "org_id" {
  description = "The ID of the Cofide organization."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-org-id"
}

variable "name" {
  description = "The name of the cloud organization."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-org"
}

variable "aws_org_id" {
  description = "The AWS Organization ID."
  type        = string
  default     = "o-exampleorgid"
}

variable "discovery_role_arn" {
  description = "The ARN of the IAM role to assume for discovery."
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cofide-discovery"
}


resource "cofide_connect_cloud_organization" "example" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = var.name

  aws = {
    aws_org_id = var.aws_org_id
    audience   = "spiffe://example.org/cloud-discovery"

    role_chain = [
      {
        iam_role_arn = var.discovery_role_arn
      }
    ]
  }

  discovery_enabled  = true
  discovery_interval = "5m"
}


output "cloud_organization_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud organization."
  value       = cofide_connect_cloud_organization.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS-specific configuration for the cloud organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `name` (String) The name of the cloud organization.
- `org_id` (String) The ID of the Cofide organization this cloud organization belongs to. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `discovery_enabled` (Boolean) Whether discovery is enabled for this cloud organization.
- `discovery_interval` (String) How frequently discovery runs for this cloud organization (a Go duration string, e.g. `1m`, `1h`). Defaults to a server-assigned value when unset.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of resource creation.
- `id` (String) The ID of the cloud organization.
- `last_discovered_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last successful discovery.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last resource update.
- `status` (String) The current status of cloud resource discovery (e.g. `DISCOVERING`, `ERROR`).

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `audience` (String) Audience value for the initial SPIFFE JWT-based assume role call.
- `aws_org_id` (String) The AWS Organization ID (e.g. `o-xxxxxxxxxx`).
- `role_chain` (Attributes List) Ordered chain of IAM roles to assume when discovering resources in this cloud organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--role_chain))

<a id="nestedatt--aws--role_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws.role_chain`

Required:

- `iam_role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role to assume.

Optional:

- `external_id` (String) Optional external ID for confused-deputy protection.
